layers.description: Remove whole files owned by initial/app-updates.
Retain the Molly updater and update preferences on the updated Signal application structure.
Resolve dynamic colors, themes and moved UI APIs while retaining Molly appearance behavior.
Remove whole files owned by initial/backup-and-restore.
Resolve backup and restore API changes while retaining Molly backup preferences and serialization behavior.
Retain the Molly map implementation and compatibility layer in the upgraded tree.
Resolve modify/delete conflicts for modules Molly removes and remove new upstream files added beneath those excluded modules.
Remove whole files owned by initial/networking-and-proxies.
Carry Molly SOCKS, Tor, DNS and transport choices through the updated Signal networking interfaces and NetCipher integration.
Remove whole files owned by initial/notifications-and-unifiedpush.
Retain MollySocket, UnifiedPush and push-selection behavior while resolving notification and delivery API changes.
Remove whole files owned by initial/payments-and-donations.
Keep MobileCoin and Google billing excluded while adapting the remaining donation and migration code.
Retain Molly privacy policies for calls, unknown contacts and logging in the updated upstream code.
Remove whole files owned by initial/registration-and-linking.
Adapt Molly registration and Android linked-device policies to the new Signal registration architecture.
Remove whole files owned by initial/resources-and-branding.
Resolve shared resource conflicts and relocated resources, retaining the port source's Molly branding and translations.
Remove whole files owned by initial/security-and-locking.
Integrate encrypted preferences, secret handling and lock-aware application behavior with the updated Signal classes.
Remove whole files owned by initial/integration.
Resolve shared application, account, service and core integration files whose APIs or feature boundaries changed upstream.
Remove whole files owned by initial/build-and-release.
Integrate the new Signal build layout and toolchain with Molly dependency, native-fork and release policies.
Retain the pinned Gradle dependency verification metadata.
Preserve new focused regression tests for Molly policies and compatibility.
Generate pinned locale translations and move locale please_wait entries to strings2.
